events.title: Release Date Announcement
events.summary: Hello dear friends ːsteamhappyːI am very happy to announce that Console War Giant will now has a release date! The game will be available on Steam on November 3rd.Now buckle up, grab your favorite merch, and get ready for the fights in the schoolyard. The Console War is about to begin!The Demo is also participating in the Steam Next Fest October. Don't hesitate to give it a try. Thanks for all the lovely feedback you gave me so far!

events.title: 1.07 Update
events.summary: Hello dear friends ! ːsteamhappyːThe update 1.07 for the demo of Console War Giant is now live. Here is the changelog :Some tracks have been replacedFixed a drawing issue un the console design windowFixed an issue with the Steam deck virtual keyboard which did not appear correctlyFixed a bug that allowed you to skip the game phase during a video hit game raceChanged concurrent companies name, logo and console design

events.title: 1.06 Update
events.summary: Hello, dear friends!Some YouTube content creators (many thanks to them! ❤️) reported copyright issues with several in-game music tracks, which prevented them from monetizing their videos.This update replaces the affected tracks, representing nearly two-thirds of the game's soundtrack.I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. I should have taken more time to fully understand how YouTube's Content ID system works before releasing the game.

events.title: 1.05 Update
events.summary: Hello dear friends !The update 1.05 for the demo of Console War Giant is now live. Here is the changelog :UI windows can now be dragged, and their stacking order can be changed.Redesigned the potential market visualization in the Game Region interface.Added an in-game hint explaining how to interpret the Market Domination information.Redesigned the Stock panel to clearly show which consoles use each hardware component.You now recover a small amount of money when demolishing a building.Increased

events.title: Demo is LIVE!
events.summary: Hello dear console lovers,Console War Giant demo is now LIVE! You can now jump in and play the demo!Experience the first decade of the console war. Get ready to lead your own company, design your consoles, secure your hardware supply, choose your games and dominate the market. Your feedback really matters.
